message: Reviewer 1 requested changes on ObserveAgent protocol 3.63 review d6f9ffaf3efa42a2a64d8f6319dd2db5 (frozen 9033bcdc). The side-effect-free ObserveAgent implementation is sound; Release validation passed (527 Client, 123 Server, focused 1, clean diff). One explicit acceptance gap: self-agent_inbox tool result exposes only post-activation Working, not a caller-visible Ready->Working before/after transition; internal AgentStateChanges is not MCP-visible, and post-activation read failures can conceal the committed transition. See findings/activation-visibility.md and summary.md. No integration/deployment.
